English: (CSCs) are hypothesised to be linked to long-term recurrence risk due to its ability to repopulate the entire tumour population in a small number of cells.
Luganda: (CSCs) buteeberezebwa okuba nga nga bwekuusa ku katyabaga k’obulwadde okuddamu ne bukomawo okumala ebbanga olw’obusobozi bwabwo okwongera ne bujjula mu butaffaali obulala obutonotono.
Yoruba: (CSCs) wà lérò pé wọ́n ní ìsopọ̀ pẹ̀lú ewu ìpadàwá ọlọ́jọ́-pípẹ́ nítorí bí ó ṣe lè gbapò gbogbo iye ìju tó wà nínú àwọn sẹ́ẹ̀lì díẹ̀ pada.
Zulu: (ama-CSC) kucatshangelwa ukuthi axhunyaniswa nengcuphe yokuphinda yesikhathi eside ngenxa yekhono layo lokugcwalisa sonke isimila enanini elincane lamaseli.
Hausa: Ana tsammani za a haɗe (CSCs) da haɗarin sake dawowa na dogon lokaci saboda ikonsa na sake cika yawan ƙarin a cikin ƙaramin adadin sel.
Northern Sotho: (di-CSC) di gopodišišwa gore di amana le kotsi ya go ipušeletša ga lebaka le letelele ka lebaka la go kgona ga yona go tlala leswa go dikutu ka moka ka go palo ye nnyane ya disele.
Amharic: (ሲኤስሲዎች) በትንሽ ህዋሳት ውስጥ ያሉትን አጠቃላይ እጢዎች እንደገና የመሙላት ችሎታ ስላላቸው ከረጅም-ጊዜ የድግግሞሽ ስጋት ጋር የተቆራኙ ናቸው ተብሎ ይገመታል።

English: In addition, CSC as according to the stem cell model, has the property of self-renewal.
Luganda: Ekyo nga kiri awo, okusinziira ku stem cell model, akataffaali ka CSC kalina enkalira y’okwezza obuggya.
Yoruba: Ní àfikún, CSC pẹ̀lú ìbámu sí módẹ̀lì sẹ́ẹ̀lì ìpìlẹ̀, ní agbára láti ṣe ìsọdituntun-fún-ra-ẹ̀.
Zulu: Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-CSC njengokusho kwemodeli ye-stem cell, inendawo yokuzivuselela.
Hausa: Bugu da ƙari, CSC kamar yadda bisa ga tsarin ƙwayar halitta, yana da mallakar sabuntawar-kai.
Northern Sotho: Godimo ga fao, CSC go ya ka mokgwa wa disele tša setemo, e na le diteng tša go ipshafatša.
Amharic: በተጨማሪም፣ ሲኤስሲ እንደ ምንጭ ህዋስ ሞዴል፣ ራሱን የማደስ ባህሪ አለው።

English: Thus, only CSC has sufficient time to accumulate adequate genetic mutations that drive the acquisition of resistance against chemo- and radiation-therapy leading to initiation of recurrence.
Luganda: Noolwekyo, CSC ke kokka akalina obudde obumala okuweza enkyukakyuka z’endagabutonde ezimala eziviirako obugugubi eri eddagala n’amaanyi agatta obutaffaali bwa kookolo olwo ne kikaviirako okukomawo.
Yoruba: Ní báyìí, CSC nìkan ní àsìkò tó tó láti ṣàkójọpò ìyípadà jíìnì kan tàbí jù bẹ́ẹ̀ lọ, èyí tó ń fa àkómọra ìtakò tó lòdì sí ìtọ́jú jẹjẹrẹ pẹ̀lú òògùn àti radíáṣọ̀nù, èyí tó jẹ́ ìpilẹ̀ṣẹ̀ fún ìpadàwá.
Zulu: Ngakho, i-CSC kuphela enesikhathi esanele sokuqongelela ukuguqulwa kofuzo okwanele okuqhuba ukutholwa kokumelana ne-chemo- kanye ne-radiation-therapy okuholela ekuqaliseni ukuphindeka.
Hausa: Domin haka, kawai CSC yana da isasshen lokaci domin tara isassun sauye-sauyen ƙwayoyin halitta waɗanda suke haifar da samun juriya daga ƙona ƙwayoyin kansa waɗanda suke haifar da farawa na sake dawowa.
Northern Sotho: Ke gore, ke fela CSC yeo e nago le nako ye e lekanego go hwetša dikopano tša ditšini tša maleba tšeo di hlohleletšago go hwetšwa ga go palelwa ga kalafo ya dikutu le ga redieišene fao go feletšago ka go thomišwa ga go tšwelela leswa.
Amharic: ስለዚህ፣ ሲኤስሲ ብቻ በቂ የዘረመል ቅይርታዎችን ለማከማቸት በቂ ጊዜ ያለው ሲሆን ይህም የኬሞ-እና የጨረር-ሕክምናን የመቋቋም አቅምን ወደማኘት ስለሚመራው ለተደጋጋሚ መከሰት ያነሳሳዋል።

English: Recently, OTX1 has been shown to be involved in the differentiation of breast CSCs into differentiated cancer cells.
Luganda: Gye buvuddeko, endagabutonde ya OTX1 ezuuliddwa okuba nga yeenyigira mu kukyusa obutaffaali obuleeta CSCs w’amabeere ne bufuuka obutaffaali bwa kookolo obukyufu.
Yoruba: Láìpẹ́, OTX1 ti fi hàn pé ó wà nínú ìṣeyàtò fún àwọn CSC ọyàn sínú sẹ́ẹ̀lì jẹjẹrẹ ọ̀tọ̀ọ̀tọ̀.
Zulu: Muva nje, i-OTX1 ikhonjiswe ukuthi iyabandakanyeka ekwehlukaniseni ama-CSC ebele abe amaseli omdlavuza ahlukene.
Hausa: A kwanan nan, an nuna OTX1 yana da hannu a cikin bambance-bambancen CSC na nono zuwa bambance-bambancen ƙwayoyin kansa.
Northern Sotho: Mo nakong ye e sa tšwago go feta, OTX1 e laeditšwe gore e kgatha tema ka pharologanong ya di-CSC tša matswele ka go disele tša kankere tše di farologantšwego.
Amharic: በቅርብ ጊዜ፣ OTX1 የጡት ሲኤስሲዎችን ወደ ተለያዩ የካንሰር ሕዋሳት በመለየት ላይ እንደሚሳተፍ ታይቷል።

English: The gene is also reported to be involved in other cancers such as subset of B cells in aggressive non-Hodgkin lymphomas, lung cancer and most recently in bladder cancer.
Luganda: Endagabutonde eyo era eyogerwako okuba nga yeenyigira mu kookolo ow’ebika ebirala gamba ng’ekika ky’obutaffaali B obubeera mu kookolo w’emisuwa, kookolo w’amawuggwe ne mu kookolo w’akawago.
Yoruba: Ìròyìn pé jíìnì náà tún kópa nínú àwọn jẹjẹrẹ mííràn bíi ọ̀wọ́ abẹ́lẹ̀ fún àwọn sẹ́ẹ̀lì B nínú àwọn Ọ́jíkín linfómà tí ò ní àwọn sẹ́ẹ̀lì oníkókó hóró méjì tó ń pọ̀ ju bó ṣe yẹ lọ, jẹjẹrẹ ẹ̀dọ àti láìpẹ́ nínú jẹjẹrẹ àpòòtọ̀.
Zulu: Lolufuzo kubikwa ukuthi lubandakanyeka kweminye imidlavuza efana ne-subset B cell kuma-aggressive non-Hodgkin lymphomas, umdlavuza wamaphaphu futhi muva nje kumdlavuza wesinye.
Hausa: An kuma bayar da rahoton cewa ƙwayar gadonr tana da hannu a cikin wasu kansa kamar su ƙaramin rukunin B a cikin kansar garkuwar jiki waɗanda ba na Hodgkin ba marasa tsanani da kansar huhu da kuma a kwanan nan a cikin kansar mafitsara.
Northern Sotho: Tšini gape go begwa gore e kgatha tema ka go hlangweng ga dikankere tše dingwe tša go swana le sehlophana sa disele tša B ka go dikankere tše kotsi tše di sego tša Hodgkin, tša kankere ya maswafo le mo nakong ye e sa tšwago go feta ka go kankere ya sebudula.
Amharic: ጂኑ እንደ ሃይለኛ የሆጅኪን-ያልሆኑ ሊምፎማዎች፣ የሳንባ ካንሰር እና በጣም በቅርብ ጊዜ በፊኛ ካንሰር ውስጥ ባሉ ሌሎች ካንሰሮች ውስጥ እንደ የቢ ህዋሳት ስብስብ ውስጥ እንደሚሳተፍ ተዘግቧል።

English: Although the involvement of OTX1 in cancers is demonstrated by limited number of studies, the gene remains to be an interesting candidate for further investigation.
Luganda: Newankubadde ng’okwenyigira kw’endagabutonde ya OTX1 mu kookolo ow’enjawulo kweyoleka n’okunoonyereza okutono okukoleddwa, endagabutonde eno erabika ng’enyuma okwongera okuginoonyerezaako.
Yoruba: Bótilẹ̀jẹ́pé ìkópa OTX1 nínú àwọn jẹjẹrẹ ti jẹ́ ìfihàn pẹ̀lú àwọn ìwádìí díẹ̀, jíìnì náà ṣì jẹ́ òǹkópa tó ń fanimọ́ra nínú ìwádìí tó ń tẹ̀síwájú.
Zulu: Nakuba ukuzibandakanya kwe-OTX1 kumdlavuza kuboniswa ngenani elilinganiselwe lezifundo, isakhi sofuzo sisalokhu singumbhekwa othokozisayo ukuze kuqhutshekwe nophenyo.
Hausa: Ko da yake shigar da OTX1 a cikin kansa ana nuna shi ta iyakance adadin bincike da ƙwayar gado ta kasance abu mai ban sha'awa domin ƙarin bincike.
Northern Sotho: Le ge e le gore go kgatha tema ga OTX1 ka dikankereng e laetšwa ke palo ya fase ya dinyakišišo, tšini ye e tšwela pele go ba seo se swanetšego go nyakišišwa go tšwela pele.
Amharic: ምንም እንኳን የOTX1 በካንሰሮች ውስጥ ያለው ተሳትፎ በተወሰኑ ጥናቶች የተረጋገጠ ቢሆንም፣ ጂኑ ለተጨማሪ ምርመራ ተፈላጊ እጩ ሆኖ ይቆያል።

English: We propose that OTX1 may be responsible for the differentiation of CSC and also promote tumour aggressiveness.
Luganda: Tuteesa nti endagabutonde ya OTX1 eyinza okuba ng’evunaanyizibwa ku kukyuka kwa CSC awamu n’okulungula okw’amangu.
Yoruba: A dábàá pé OTX1 lè jẹ́ ìdí fún ìṣàyàtọ̀ CSC, àti pé ó tún ṣe ìgbéga fún pípọ̀ ìju kíá ju bó ṣe yẹ lọ.
Zulu: Siphakamisa ukuthi i-OTX1 ingaba nesibopho sokuhlukaniswa kwe-CSC futhi ikhuthaze nokuba nolaka lwesimila.
Hausa: Muna bayar da shawarar cewa OTX1 yana iya zama alhakin bambance-bambancen CSC kuma yana haɓaka tsananin ƙari.
Northern Sotho: Re šišinya gore OTX1 e ka ba yona e rwelego maikarabelo a go farologanywa ga CSC le gape go tšwetša pele go keka ga dikutu.
Amharic: OTX1 ለሲኤስሲ መለየት ተጠያቂ ሊሆን እንደሚችል እና የእጢ ሃይለኛነትንም ጭምር እንደሚያበረታታ ሃሳባችንን እናቀርባለን።

English: We plan to establish the expression and localisation patterns of OTX1 gene for Nigerian bladder cancer patients and correlate with clinical characteristics such as stage and grade; risk of recurrence; disease progression and age.
Luganda: Tuteekateeka okunoonyereza ku nneeyoleka n’enseetuka y’endagabutonde ya OTX1 mu balwadde b’e Nigeria abalina kookolo w’akawago n’oluvannyuma tubikwataganye n’enkalira zaako gamba ng’eddaala; akatyabaga k’okukomawo, enseetuka y’endwadde n’emyaka.
Yoruba: A ṣétò láti ṣèdásílẹ̀ bátànì bí jíìnì OTX1 ṣe maa ń ṣẹ̀dá mólékú tó nílò àti ètò ibi tó maa ń wà fún àwọn aláìsàn jẹjẹrẹ apòòtọ̀ ní Nigeria, ó sì wà ní ìbámu pẹ̀lú àwọn àbùdá ajẹmówòsàn bíi, ìpele àti ipò; ewu ìpadàwá; ìtẹ̀síwájú àìsàn àti ọjọ́-orí.
Zulu: Sihlela ukusungula amaphethini okuveza kanye nokwenza kwasendaweni kofuzo lwe-OTX1 ezigulini zomdlavuza wesinye waseNigeria futhi sihlobane nezici zomtholampilo ezifana nesigaba kanye nebanga; ingozi yokuphinda; ukukhula kwesifo kanye neminyaka.
Hausa: Mun yi shirin kafa tsarin bayyanawa da kuma tsarin gano asalin ƙwayar gadon OTX1 ga masu cutar kansar mafitsara ta Nijeriya da kuma daidaitawa da halaye na asibiti kamar mataki da matsayi; haɗarin sake dawowa; ci gaban cuta da kuma shekaru.
Northern Sotho: Re beakanya go hlama go tšweletša le go bea mekgwa ya ka nageng ya tšini ya OTX1 go balwetši ba kankere ya sebudula ba ka Nigeria le go sepelelana le dipharologantši tša kalafo tša go swana le legato le kreiti; kotsi ya go ipušeletša; go keka ga bolwetši le mengwaga.
Amharic: ለናይጄሪያ የፊኛ ካንሰር በሽተኞች የOTX1 ጂንን አገላለጽ እና የአካባቢያዊነት ዘይቤዎችን ለመመስረት እና እንደ የሚገኝበት ደረጃ እና ዓይነት፤ የድግግሞሽ ስጋት፤ የበሽታው እድገት እና ዕድሜ ያሉ ክሊኒካዊ ባህሪያት ጋር ለማዛመድ አቅደናል።

English: To understand the role of OTX1 in bladder cancer stem cells, the gene will be overexpressed/knockdown in non OTX1 expressing and OTX1 expressing CSCs, respectively, and the resulting phenotypic effects will be compared.
Luganda: Okusobola okutegeera omulimu gw’endagabutonde ya OTX1 mu butaffaali obuleeta kookolo w’akawago, endagabutonde ejja kuteekebwa mu OTX1 etayoleka butaffaali buleeta kookolo awamu n’endagabutonde ya OTX1 eyoleka CSCs, olwo ebivaamu bigeraageranyizibwe.
Yoruba: Láti mọ àmọ̀dunjú nípa ipa tí OTX1 ń kó nínú àwọn sẹ́ẹ̀lì ìpìlẹ̀ jẹjẹrẹ àpòòtọ̀, ìṣiṣẹ́ jíìnì nínú àwọn sẹ́ẹ̀lì tó ti ń gbó/ìdínkù ìṣiṣẹ́ jíìnì nínú àwọn CSC OTX1 tí ò ṣiṣẹ́ àti OTX1 tó ń ṣiṣẹ́ lẹ́sẹẹsẹ, ìfiwéra ìrí-hùwà-dàgbà-sí wọn sì máa wàyé.
Zulu: Ukuze kuqondwe indima ye-OTX1 kumaseli esiqu somdlavuza wesinye, isakhi sofuzo sizovezwa ngokwedlulele/sishaye phansi ngendlela engeyona i-OTX1 evezwayo kanye ne-OTX1 eveza ama-CSCs, ngokulandelana, futhi imiphumela ewumphumela ye-finothayiphi izoqhathaniswa.

English: Researchers want to study a gene called “OTX1” because it seems to allow bladder cancer to escape the effects of anticancer drugs.

Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí fẹ́ ṣe ìwádìí jíìnì kan tí wọ́n pè ní “OYX1” nítorí ó dàbí pé ó fàyè gba jẹjẹrẹ àpòòtọ̀ láti móríbọ́ nínú àwọn ìṣiṣẹ́ àwọn ògùn tó ń tako jẹjẹrẹ.

Hausa: Masu bincike suna son yin nazarin ƙwayar gado mai suna "OTX1" saboda da alama tana bayar da damar kansar mafitsara domin tserewa tasirin magungunan maganin kansa.
Northern Sotho: Bnayakišiša ba nyaka g nyakišiša ka ga tšini ye e bitšwago “OTX1” ka ge e bonala e dumelela kankere ya sebudula go tšhabela diabe tša dihlare tša twantšho ya kankere.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎች የፊኛ ካንሰርን ከፀረ-ካንሰር መድኃኒት ተጽእኖ ለማስመለጥ የሚፈቅድ ስለሚመስል “OTX1” የተባለውን ጂን ማጥናት ይፈልጋሉ።

English: Since the cancer often recurs despite treatment, understanding how the gene works may be important for developing better cancer therapies.
Luganda: Engeri gye kiri nti kookolo atera okukomawo wadde ng’ajjanjabiddwa, okutegeera enkola y’endagabutonde kuyinza okuba okw’omuwendo mu kukulaakulanya eddagala lya kookolo erisingako.
Yoruba: Nígbà tí jẹjẹrẹ náà maa ń ṣábà padà lẹ́yìn ìtọ́jú, níní òyé bí jíìnì náà ṣe ń ṣiṣẹ́ lè jẹ́ pàtàkì fún ìlọsíwájú àwọn ìtọjú ìpadàbọ́sípò jẹjẹrẹ tó dára ju ti tẹ́lẹ̀ lọ.
Zulu: Njengoba umdlavuza uvame ukuvela naphezu kokwelashwa, ukuqonda ukuthi ufuzo lusebenza kanjani kungase kubaluleke kakhulu ekuthuthukiseni izindlela zokwelapha ezingcono zomdlavuza.
Hausa: Tun da kanar takan sake dawowa duk da jiyya, fahimtar yadda ƙwayoyin gadon suke aiki yana iya zama da mahimmanci domin haɓaka ingantattun hanyoyin magance cutar kansa.
Northern Sotho: Ka ge e le gore kankere gantši e a ipušeletša le ge e alafša, go kwešiša ka fao tšini e šomago ka gona go ka ba bohlokwa go hlama dikalafo tša kankere.
Amharic: ህክምናው ቢደረግም ካንሰሩ ብዙ ጊዜ በተደጋጋሚ ስለሚከሰት፣ ጂኑ እንዴት እንደሚሰራ መረዳት የተሻሉ የካንሰር ህክምናዎችን ለማዘጋጀት ጠቃሚ ሊሆን ይችላል።

English: Researchers say that cancer stem cells (CSC) might be the reason for cancer returning after treatments (recurrence), because they can form a tumour able to resist or fight off cancer drugs.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza bagamba nti obutaffaali obuleeta kookolo (CSC) buyinza okuba nga y’ensonga ereetera kookolo okudda oluvannyuma lw’okujjanjabwa (okukomawo), kubanga busobola okukola okulungula okusobola okulemesa oba okulwanyisa eddagala lya kookolo.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí sọ pé àwọn sẹ́ẹ̀lì ìpìlẹ̀ jẹjẹrẹ (CSC) lè jẹ́ ìdí fún ìpadàwá jẹjẹrẹ lẹ́yìn àwọn ìtọ́jú (ìpadàwá), nítorí wọ́n lè dí ìju tó lè kojú tàbí bá àwọn òògùn jẹjẹrẹ jà.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathi iziqu zeseli zomdlavuza(CSC) zingaba isizathu sokubuya komdlavuza ngemva kokwelashwa (ukuphindaphinda), ngoba zingenza isimila esikwazi ukumelana noma ukulwa nemithi yomdlavuza.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce.Masu bincike sun ce ƙwayoyin kansa (CSC) suna iya zama dalilin kansa mai dawowa bayan jiyya (sake dawowa), saboda suna iya haifar da kansa wanda zai iya jure ko yaƙi da magungunan kansa.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba bolela gore disele tša setemo sa kankere (CSC) di ka ba lebaka leo kankere e bowago ka morago ga go alafiwa (go ipušeletša), ka ge di kgona go hlama sekutu seo se kgonago go paella goba go lwantšha dihlare tša kankere.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎች የካንሰር ምንጭ ህዋሳት (ሲኤስሲ) ከህክምናው በኋላ ለሚመለሰው ካንሰር ምክንያት ሊሆኑ (ድግግሞሽ) ይችላል ብለዋል፣ ምክንያቱም የካንሰር መድሃኒቶችን ለመቋቋም ወይም ለመዋጋት የሚችል እጢ ሊፈጠሩ ይችላሉ።

English: In bladder cancer specifically, researchers have shown that a gene called OTX1 might be responsible for this effect.
Luganda: Bwe kituuka ku kookolo w’akawago, abanoonyereza balaze nti endagabutonde eyitibwa OTX1 eyinza okuba ng’evunaanyizibwa okumuleeta.
Yoruba: Nínú jẹjẹrẹ àpòòtọ̀ ní pàtó, àwọn aṣèwádìí ti fi hàn pé jíìnì kan tí wọ́n pé ní OTX1 lè jẹ́ ìdí fún ipa yìí.
Zulu: Emdlavuzeni wesinye ikakhulukazi, abacwaningi bakhombisile ukuthi ufuzo olubizwa nge-OTX1 lungaba nembangela yalo mphumela.
Hausa: A cikin kansar mafitsara musamman, masu bincike sun nuna cewa ƙwayar gado mai suna OTX1 tana iya zama alhakin wannan tasirin.
Northern Sotho: Ka go kankere ya sebudula kudukudu, banyakišiši ba bontšhitše gore tšini ye e bitšwago OTX1 e ka ba yona e bakago seabe se.
Amharic: የፊኛ ካንሰር ላይ በተለይ፣ ተመራማሪዎች ለዚህ ውጤት ተጠያቂው OTX1 የተባለ ጂን ሊሆን እንደሚችል አሳይተዋል።

English: In 2020 researchers proposed to study the exact mechanism of this gene, in other words how it is able to protect bladder tumours from current medicines.
Luganda: Mu mwaka gwa 2020, abanoonyereza baateesa okwekaliriza enkola y’endagabutonde eno, mu bufunze nga baagala okulaba engeri gy’ekuumamu okulungula kw’akawago obutakolwako ddagala liriwo kaakano.
Yoruba: Ní 2020, àwọn aṣẹ̀wádìí dábàá láti ṣe ìwádìí ètò pàtó jíìnì yìí, ní kúkúrú, bí ó ṣe ń dáàbòbò àwọn ìju àpòòtọ̀ lọ́wọ́ àwọn òògùn ìgbàyí.
Zulu: Ngowe-2020 abacwaningi bahlongoza ukuthi kucwaningwe indlela okuyiyonayona yalolu fuzo, ngamanye amazwi ukuthi lukwazi kanjani ukuvikela izimila zesinye emithini yamanje.
Hausa: A cikin shekarar 2020 masu bincike sun bayar da shawarar yin nazarin ainihin tsarin wannan ƙwayar gado, a taƙaice yadda zai iya kare ƙari-ƙari na mafitsara daga magungunan yanzu.
Northern Sotho: Ka 2020 banyakišiši ba ile ba šišinya go nyakišiša mokgwa wa maleba wa tšini ye, ka mantšu a mangwe ka fao e kgonago go šireletša dikuti tša sebudula go dihlare tša bjale.
Amharic: በ2020 ተመራማሪዎች የዚህን ጂን ትክክለኛ ዘዴ፣ በሌላ አነጋገር የፊኛ እጢዎችን አሁን ካሉ መድኃኒቶች እንዴት እንደሚከላከል ለማጥናት ሃሳባቸውን አቅርበዋል።

English: They planned to collect samples from Nigerian bladder cancer patients to see how common the OTX1 gene is.
Luganda: Baateekateeka okukuŋŋaanya sampolo okuva mu balwadde b’e Nigeria abalina kookolo w’akawago okulaba enneeyoleka y’endagabutonde ya OTX1.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣètò áti gba àwọn àpẹẹrẹ láti ara àwọn aláìsàn jẹjẹrẹ àpòòtọ̀ ní Nigeria láti mọ bí jíìnì OTX1 ṣe wọ́pọ̀ tó.
Zulu: Bahlele ukuqoqa amasampula ezigulini zomdlavuza wesinye eNigeria ukuze babone ukuthi ufuzo lwe-OTX1 luvame kangakanani.
Hausa: Sun yi shirin tattara samfurori daga masu fama da cutar kansar mafitsara a Nijeriya domin ganin yadda ƙwayar gadon OTX1 ta zama ruwan dare.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba beakanya go kgoboketša disampole go tša go balwetši ba kankere ya sedudula ba ka Nigeria go bona ka fao tšini ya OTX1 e tlwaelegilego ka gona.
Amharic: የOTX1 ጂን ምን ያህል የተለመደ እንደሆነ ለማየት ከናይጄሪያ የፊኛ ካንሰር በሽተኞች ናሙናዎችን ለመሰብሰብ አቅደው ነበር።

English: They want to see what happens in the cell when the gene is switched on or off, and if it changes the features of bladder cancer.
Luganda: Baagala kulaba ekituukawo mu butaffaali ng’endagabutonde eteekeddwako oba ng’eggyiddwako, awamu n’okulaba oba nga kino kikyusa enkalira za kookolo w’akawago.
Yoruba: Wọ́n fẹ́ rí ohun tó maa ń ṣẹlẹ̀ nínú sẹ́ẹ̀lì nígbà tí jíìnì náà bá wà ní títàn tàbí pípa, àti tí ó bá yí àwọn ẹ̀yà jẹjẹrẹ àpòòtọ̀ padà.
Zulu: Bafuna ukubona ukuthi kwenzekani eselini lapho isakhi sofuzo sivuliwe noma sicishiwe, futhi uma kushintsha izici zomdlavuza wesinye.
Hausa: Suna son ganin abin da yake faruwa a cikin tantanin halitta a lokacin da aka kunna ko kashe ƙwayar gado, da kuma idan ta canza fasalin cutar kansar mafitsara.
Northern Sotho: Ba nyaka go bona gore go direga eng ka gare ga sele ge tšini e gotetšwa goba go tingwa, le ge e fetoga ditlabelo tša kankere ya sebudula.
Amharic: የፊኛ ካንሰር ገፅታዎችን የሚቀይር ከሆነ፣ ጂን ሲበራ ወይም ሲጠፋ (በጂን ቁጥጥር ጊዜ) በህዋስ ውስጥ ምን እንደሚፈጠር ማየት ይፈልጋሉ።

English: This would have been the first investigation into the OTX1 gene in bladder cancer at the time, and having this information could help improve treatments that would lead to bladder cancer remission.
Luganda: Kuno kwe kwandibadde okunoonyereza okusoose okukolebwa ku ndagabutonde ya OTX1 mu kookolo w’akawago mu kiseera ekyo, era okuba n’obubaka buno kuyinza okuyambako mu kutumbula obujjanjabi obuyinza okuyambako mu kuvumula kookolo.
Yoruba: Èyí ko bá ti jẹ́ iṣẹ́ ìwádìí àkọ́kọ́ sínú jíìnì OTX1 nínú jẹjẹrẹ àpòòtọ̀ nígbà náà, àti níní àlàyé tó lè ṣe ìrànwọ́ láti ṣe ìtẹ̀síwájú nínú àwọn ìtọ́jú tó lè darí sí ìdínkù jẹjẹrẹ àpòòtọ̀.
Zulu: Lolu bekungaba uphenyo lokuqala olwenziwa ohlotsheni lofuzo lwe-OTX1 kumdlavuza wesinye ngaleso sikhathi, futhi ukuba nalolu lwazi kungasiza ekuthuthukiseni ukwelashwa okungaholela ekukhululweni komdlavuza wesinye.
Hausa: Wannan zai zama bincike na farko a cikin ƙwayar gadon OTX1 a cikin kansar mafitsara a lokacin, kuma samun wannan bayanin zai iya taimakawa wajen inganta jiyya da za ta haifar da warkar da kansar mafitsara.
Northern Sotho: Se se ka be se bile dinyakišišo tša mathmo ka ga tšini ya OTX1 ka go kankere ya sebudula ka nako yeo, gomme go ba le tshedimošo ye go ka thuša go kaonafatša dikalafo tšeo di ka feletšago ka go hwa ga kankere ya sebudula.
Amharic: ይህ በጊዜው በOTX1 ጂን ላይ የፊኛ ካንሰር ውስጥ የመጀመሪያ ምርመራ ሊሆን ይችላል፣ እና ይህን መረጃ ማግኘት ወደ ፊኛ ካንሰር ስርየት የሚያመሩ ህክምናዎችን ለማሻሻል ሊያግዝ ይችላል።

English: (Cancer remission is when cancer signs and symptoms disappear partially or completely.)
Luganda: (Okuvumula kookolo y’embeera mwe tulabira ng’obubonero bwa kookolo bugenda bubulawo mpolampola oba ne buggweerawo ddala.)
Yoruba: (Ìdínkù jẹjẹrẹ ni ìgbà tí àwọn àmì jẹjẹrẹ bá pòórá díẹ̀ tàbí pátápátá.)
Zulu: (Ukukhululwa komdlavuza yilapho izimpawu zomdlavuza zinyamalala kancane noma ngokuphelele.)
Hausa: (Warkar da kansa shi ne a lokacin da alamun cutar kansa da alamun cutar kansa suka ragu ko ɓace gabaɗaya.)
Northern Sotho: (Go hwa ga kankere ke ge maswao le dika tša kankere di tloga ka seripa goba ka moka ga tšona.)
Amharic: (የካንሰር ስርየት ማለት የካንሰር መለያዎች እና ምልክቶች በከፊል ወይም ሙሉ በሙሉ ሲጠፉ ነው።) ይህንን ጥናት ያቀረቡት ተመራማሪዎች ከናይጄሪያ የመጡ ናቸው።

English: The researchers who proposed this study are from Nigeria.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza abaateesa okunoonyereza kuno bava mu ggwanga lya Nigeria.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí tí wọ́n dábàá iṣẹ́-ìwádìí yìí wá láti Nigeria.
Zulu: Abacwaningi abaphakamise lolu cwaningo bavela eNigeria.
